sources.entry: Fredy ⚠ - Searches for new apartments, houses, and flats in Germany on platforms like ImmoScout24, Immowelt, and others, and instantly delivers the results to you via Slack, Telegram, and more. (Demo, Source Code) Apache-2.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: Fredy is a self-hosted real estate finder that watches 29 European property portals (mainly Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Spain, Italy, Portugal and France) and pushes new listings to chat and notification services.
summary.what_it_does: Fredy runs searches against real estate portals such as ImmoScout24, Immowelt, Kleinanzeigen, WG-Gesucht and willhaben, using search URLs pasted from each portal. It deduplicates listings that appear on several platforms, matching on living space, rooms and location. New listings are sent through configured channels including Slack, Telegram, Email, ntfy, Discord, Gotify, Mattermost, Pushover and Apprise. Searches, channels and settings are managed in a Web UI and stored in a database. The README also describes a financing calculator, travel time calculation from user addresses, a rental scam warning heuristic, price-per-m² benchmarking, document uploads per listing, and an MCP server for querying listings from LLM clients.
use_cases: get alerted to new apartment listings in Germany
monitor rental flats across multiple portals
receive property alerts in Telegram or Slack
compare listing prices per square metre
estimate affordability of rent or purchase
check commute time from a listing to my address
query property listings from an LLM assistant
how_to_run: docker run -d --name fredy -v fredy_conf:/conf -v fredy_db:/db -p 9998:9998 ghcr.io/orangecoding/fredy:master
Open http://localhost:9998 and sign in with admin / admin
Node.js 22.22.0 or higher required for non-Docker setup
notable: Cross-platform deduplication that matches listings on living space, rooms and location rather than headline text
Rental scam detection that warns when several fraud signals appear in a listing
Travel times from your own address by public transport, car, bike or foot
Built-in MCP server for querying listings from Claude, ChatGPT or a local LLM
Channel and job model that lets one notification channel be reused across many searches
caveats: License adds Commons Clause and attribution conditions, so it is source-available rather than OSI open source; commercial use is restricted
Relies on a reverse engineered ImmoScout Mobile API
Travel time data depends on the community-run Transitous service, which asks for considerate load
Default admin/admin credentials must be changed after first login
summary.license: Apache-2.0 (with Commons Clause and attribution conditions)
